message.content: {"mentions":[{"ref":"m1","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m2","surface":"趙","occurrence":1},{"ref":"m3","surface":"隴西天水人","occurrence":2},{"ref":"m4","surface":"未莊人","occurrence":3}],"relations":[{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m2","type":"同乡邻里","evidence":[{"quote":"倘他姓趙，則據現在好稱郡望的老例，可以照郡名百家姓上的注解，說是『隴西天水人也』","occurrence":0}]},{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m4","type":"同乡邻里","evidence":[{"quote":"不能說是未莊人，卽使說是『未莊人也』，也仍然有乖史法的","occurrence":1}]}],"alias_proposals":[]}
